OWNERSHIP CORRECTION (worktree source-read, daemonkit HEAD 85d53fd): daemonkit does NOT emit LimitLoadToSessionType anywhere. It declares the exported Agent field (service/service.go:126-128), renders it when set (:48-51), reads it for the EIO diagnostic (controller.go:595), and checks JSON key PRESENCE in stored agents (controller_state.go:900-914 — a consumer zeroing the field round-trips fine). The emitters are consumers: synckit daemon/service.go:87 (helper session mapping — the "serviceAgents()/canonicalHelperProgram()" cited in this task's body are synckit files, not daemonkit's), captain-hook internal/hookd/deployment.go:176/:182 (+ persisted policy :230/:235), cc-notes internal/helperdeployment/deployment_identity.go:345.

USER VERDICT (2026-07-26): fix both helper bugs now, full scope. Ratified mapping, uniform across all three consumers: Background-family → ProcessType Background (resource intent survives); Aqua → dropped (no analogue, redundant in gui domain, and a live SSH-context risk — machines upgrade over SSH). Three implementation lanes in flight (synckit carries this fix AND 74be91d7; captain-hook; cc-notes). The daemonkit release freeze can HOLD unless the staging fix needs a daemonkit API change — consumer releases (synckit, captain-hook, cc-notes) carry the fixes. Remaining daemonkit-side candidate: a godoc warning on Agent.LimitLoadToSessionType that launchctl bootstrap refuses session-limited plists in observed configurations.
